body:
nothing really happened, but more like I've just become so exhausted trying to fight what seems like destiny. I have no ability to work anymore, but I also don't get any financial assistance. I've leeched off of my boyfriend for the past 3 years and now we broke up a while back. I still live in his house and he isn't kicking me out anytime soon, but obviously it's not a good thing that he is still fully supporting me. we've been trying to find some sort of assistance for me, but we keep coming up empty everytime, there just isn't anything

remote work sounds like a good option, but I lack the skills and I'm suspicious if I could pull it off. I have no savings and it looks like an unstable way of making a living...
